messages:
Mina: Quick thread — tiny refresh for the 'Hello Seed' quickstart. Goals: add a minimal C# example, tidy the CLI auth instructions, and fix the broken anchor to /deploy/production#quickstart-deploy.
Connor: 👍 Where do we want to standardize the env var? REDWOOD_API_KEY still appears in a couple of guides.
Mina: Use RW_API_KEY as canonical. We'll add a one-line migration tip for REDWOOD_API_KEY -> RW_API_KEY.
Lea: I can write the C# snippet. Keep it minimal (HttpClient + Bearer header) so .NET devs can copy-paste. Also add a tiny note that the sample targets .NET 7.
Mina: Nice. Also update the CLI section to show both POSIX and PowerShell examples so windows users don't get tripped up.
Lea: Draft C# snippet (short):
```csharp
// Program.cs
using System.Net.Http;
var client = new HttpClient();
client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new System.Net.Http.Headers.AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("RW_API_KEY"));
var resp = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", new { model = "seed-mini", prompt = "Hello" });
Console.WriteLine(await resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
```
Connor: Perfect. For CLI auth, show export and ps examples and a curl example that uses the env var: 
```
# POSIX
export RW_API_KEY=sk-...
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" -d '{"model":"seed-mini","prompt":"Hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# PowerShell
$env:RW_API_KEY = 'sk-...'
```
Alex: CI flagged dotnet sdk version mismatch in the samples container (was using 6.0). Should target 7.0. I'll update samples/Dockerfile and add a short note in README about required SDK.
Mina: Good catch. Add engines note: ".NET SDK 7+" and a fallback link to install docs.
Connor: Also add a tiny migrate-env script that sets RW_API_KEY from REDWOOD_API_KEY if present, to reduce breakage for internal users.
Lea: I'll keep the C# snippet under 12 lines and add an expected output line to the quickstart so readers know it worked.
Mina: Branch created docs/quickstart-csharp-cli and PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8452 (PR body lists env rename, C# example, CLI auth, dotnet7 note, anchor fix).
DocsBot: Link check queued for PR #8452
CI-Bot: CI started for PR #8452 — running unit tests and samples smoke.
Alex: CI failed on samples smoke due to Dockerfile using mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:6.0. Changed to 7.0 and re-triggered.
DocsBot: Link check passed for PR #8452
CI-Bot: CI green after dotnet update.
Mina: Thanks — requested reviews from Lea/Connor/Alex. Targeting merge tomorrow AM. Will post the preview URL on merge. :eyes:
Connor: :thumbsup:
Lea: LGTM once the migration note is in the top callout.
Mina: Added the migration callout and a one-liner about token rotation/KMS. Closing loop for now — will follow up after merge.
